## Video lecture attribution

The **Video lectures** section at the end of several modules links out to full-length teaching lectures from the University of Utah's [Echocardiography & Perioperative Ultrasound](https://echo.anesthesia.med.utah.edu/tee/focus-content/) FoCUS program. These lectures are hosted on and remain the property of the University of Utah; this curriculum links to them and does not host or reproduce the video content.

| Module | Lecture(s) |
|---|---|
| 1 — Windows & Acquisition | What is FoCUS?; Basic Anatomy for the Echocardiographer; Basic Ultrasound Concepts; How to Perform the FoCUS Exam |
| 2 — LV Function | FoCUS on the Left; FoCUS for LV Ischemia |
| 3 — RV Function | FoCUS for the RV |
| 6 — Lung Ultrasound | Lung Ultrasound 101; Point-of-Care Lung Ultrasound Part 2 |
| 7 — Abdominal | Abdominal Ultrasound; FAST for Anesthesiologists; Gastric Ultrasound |
| 8 — DVT | DVT Ultrasound |
| 9 — Integration | FoCUS to the Rescue!; Cognitive Bias and Errors in Imaging |

---

## Ultrasound clip attribution

All clips used in this curriculum are sourced from [The POCUS Atlas](https://www.thepocusatlas.com), an open-access point-of-care ultrasound image library. We are grateful to the contributors who submitted these cases.

::: {.callout-note}
Clips marked with an asterisk (\*) are embedded in the curriculum but do not yet have complete contributor metadata. If you are the contributor, please contact the curriculum team.
:::
